XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Various engine warning lights come on, with vehicle functioning correctly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | SENSOR | COUNTERPRESSURE | FILTER | PARTICULATE | ANTI-PARTICULATE | P0474 | LIGHTS UP | ON | MIL | YELLOW | WORKS | CORRECTLY | NORMAL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage technician; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Exhaust gas pressure sensor

  • Fault: The vehicle’s engine fault warning light is illuminated, whilst the engine continues to run normally

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics: P0474 (Exhaust gas pressure sensor – temporary interruption)

  • Cause: Fault in the exhaust gas pressure sensor

• Action: Check and, if necessary, replace the exhaust gas pressure sensor

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Before proceeding with the replacement, it is advisable to check the condition of the sensor’s rubber hoses.

    Also check that they are clear and not blocked by carbon deposits.

    Following replacement of the sensor it is necessary to carry out the value calibration procedure using diagnostic equipment

    The component is accessible from the engine compartment near the windscreen, on the passenger side.
